shared_training.optimizer_defaults_evidence: Recovered source calls torch.optim.AdamW without overriding betas or eps.
shared_training.epoch_selection: minimum validation cross entropy, first epoch attaining a new strict minimum
shared_training.test_endpoint: restore minimum-validation-loss weights before the saved test evaluation
shared_training.precision: CUDA autocast: bfloat16 when supported, float16 otherwise; CUDA GradScaler. CPU uses float32.
shared_training.randomization: sha256_named_streams_v1; initialization and minibatch streams depend on base seed, dropout stream depends on full trial spec with early/late profile family collapsed
shared_training.final_test_availability: Recorded only for retained Tiny ImageNet 80k cohorts. Saved per-epoch curves are train/validation, not test.

initialization.readout: same Gaussian rule as hidden layers

transformer.normalization: two pre-LayerNorms per block, epsilon=1e-5; final LayerNorm
transformer.residual_structure: x <- x + dropout(attention(LN(x))); x <- x + dropout(MLP(LN(x)))
transformer.dropout: same layer probability at attention-output and feedforward-output residual branches; separate masks at each call; attention-weight dropout=0
transformer.attention: full noncausal scaled dot-product; joint QKV linear has no bias; output projection has bias
transformer.embedding: learned CLS token plus learned absolute position embedding
transformer.initialization: Linear weights and CLS/position embeddings: truncated Normal(std=0.02), linear biases=0, LayerNorm weight=1,bias=0; image patch Conv2d uses PyTorch default initialization
transformer.mlp_theory_status: empirical extension; Gaussian critical MLP initialization does not describe Transformer dynamics

zero_decay_three_stage.evidence: Recovered protocol generator; complete historical search outputs are not included in the confirmation export.

budget_search.learning_rate: hold each profile's LR-search winner fixed

zero_decay_three_stage.candidate_criterion: minimum mean of per-seed minimum validation cross entropy; ties then lower LR, then lower mean dropout

linear_followup.criterion: minimum validation cross entropy selects LR per profile, then better linear direction
linear_followup.matching_uniform_baseline: not present in retained export; do not borrow zero-decay baseline
